mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.customer_id, f.competitor_id, cp.project_name AS competitor_name, f.focus_content, f.created_by, u.nickname AS created_by_name, f.created_at FROM crm_customer_competitor_focus f LEFT JOIN crm_competitor_project cp ON f.competitor_id = cp.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON f.created_by = u.id WHERE f.customer_id = #{customerId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
